32a0194.summary: Enters ability-targeting UI state, shows potential targets, positions the crosshair at the acting card and sets spell colours; decompiler output is mostly mangled DOTween internals.

32a0748.summary: Validates the clicked ability target; on success executes the active ability, otherwise shows an invalid-target tip and cancels, then hides the crosshair and attack selector.

32a0714.summary: Cancels the pending active ability on the selected card and fades out the acting light on the skill display.

32a0898.summary: Checks whether using an active ability on the target is allowed by the current tutorial script step.

32a0954.summary: Checks whether potential attack targets may be shown for the card, respecting tutorial scripted actions.

32a0c18.summary: Starts a targeted active ability for the selected card and highlights all valid ability targets on the board.

3293e28.summary: Hides the target reticle crosshair and the attack type selector.

32a0d18.summary: Shows or hides the attack type mark selector for a card and moves it to the card position.

32a0d40.summary: Returns true if any actions are queued or an action is currently being resolved.

32a0dc4.summary: Logs all pending actions in the action, instant, interrupt and delayed instant queues.

32a0df0.summary: Logs every pending action in the given battle action queue.

32a0ff0.summary: Logs a compressed summary of the interrupt, instant, delayed instant and action queues, with the last logged only when dev tools are active.

32a1154.summary: Builds a single string summarising each action in the queue by index, action type and acting card.

3296b34.summary: Returns the total count of actions in the interrupt, instant and delayed instant queues.

32852cc.summary: Returns the total count of actions across the action, instant, interrupt and delayed instant queues.

32a151c.summary: Spawns the hero's targeted spell animation prefab at the current hero position, if the hero has one.

3293e68.summary: Stops the targeted spell animation by destroying its GameObject.

3285b14.summary: Returns whether it is the player's turn by decrypting the obscured player turn flag.

328ada8.summary: Returns true if any queued action is a blocking action, notifying the player to wait if it is their turn.

329ebec.summary: Determines whether a card can be played, checking turn, queue state, tutorial, mana, board space and spell targets, showing tips on failure.

32a17b0.summary: Returns the unused mana of the player or enemy manager as a decrypted obscured int.

32a17d8.summary: Returns the total mana of the player or enemy manager as a decrypted obscured int.

32a1800.summary: Spends mana for playing a card, checks codex trigger, and raises an energy spent signal.

32a1a10.summary: Spends oath mana for an active ability, checks codex trigger, and raises an energy spent signal.

32a1b28.summary: Spends oath mana when a card with oath is played and queues a codex trigger action if no mana remains.

32a1934.summary: Queues a trigger-player-codex action when mana left is zero and the card cost qualifies.

327ee2c.summary: Returns the player hand or enemy hand depending on the flag.

3280fac.summary: Returns the player or enemy minion manager depending on the flag.

32809ec.summary: Returns the player or enemy player manager depending on the flag.

3291cc0.summary: Checks whether the attacker can legally attack the target given traits, tutorial, defenders and destroyers, showing tips on failure.

32a1be4.summary: Simulates melee and ranged damage against the target, accounting for armour, shield, dodge, drop pod, survivor and bastion, to determine if the attack kills it.

32a0a2c.summary: Checks whether the target is a valid target for the given targeted spell, considering turn, tutorial, stealth, ward and camouflage.

329f70c.summary: Checks whether the target is valid for the acting card's active ability, considering turn, tutorial, stealth, ward and summon rift.

32a16f0.summary: Returns true if any unit in play is a valid target for the given targeted spell.

32a1ebc.summary: Counts units of the given side in play that have the double oath trait.

32a00d4.summary: Returns true if any unit in play is a valid target for the acting card's active ability.

32a1fa0.summary: Creates and displays a revealed card in the centre of the screen as an offensive card display.

32a2178.summary: Shows the large card display with its effects for a card, with special handling for ambush cards and UI state checks.

32a22d8.summary: On focus gain on Android, hides the system UI via the Android window view, or resets the screen resolution on old SDKs.

32a2360.summary: Finds the card under the mouse position by raycasting the 2D board and then the 3D scene, returning the hit CardScript.
